newsitem.title: USA: Teltrend stock plummets on earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Teltrend stock plummets on earnings warning.

text.p: The stock of Teltrend Inc., a maker of telephone transmission products, lost 25 percent of its value Wednesday after the company warned that its quarterly earnings would fall short of a year earlier.
Teltrend fell $5.875 to $17.125 on the Nasdaq market.

The company reported late Tuesday that it expected to report lower sales and earnings for its fiscal second quarter that ends on Jan. 25 compared with year-ago levels. It did not provide specific estimates.
Before the warning, analysts were forecasting earnings of 49 cents a share, vs. earnings of 41 cents a share and sales of $20.5 million in the year-earlier quarter.
At least one analyst cut his rating on the stock.
"Basically their business in December all but dried up," said Greg Mesniaeff, an analyst for Robinson-Humphrey.

Chandan Sarkar, an analyst at SoundView Financial Group, said he viewed Teltrend's current difficulties as "structural, not fundamental," reflecting the regional phone companies' efforts to reorganize their businesses.
He believes the problem would correct itself by the end of the year.
